title: Agent tool contracts for the cases every model fails, so cheaper models pass
description: From MPI-912's DeepInfra agent survey (2026-09-25, .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-912/validation.md section 5): eleven models ran the 22-case suite (scripts/agent-test.mjs); only our pick deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 passes 22/22 x3, and the prompts and tools were tuned on it. Four cases fail on nearly every other model, which points at our contracts, not only the models: rerun-on-named-model (runs i2i with the picture as media instead of a t2i re-run on the named model), sheet-goes-to-reference (sends a character sheet as a start frame to i2v instead of ref2v), over-boxed-head (never measures the box; runs Head Swap on a box covering the whole person), ranked-editor (takes krea2Edit over the top-ranked kleinEdit). Fabio (2026-09-25): adjust our side so lesser and cheaper models pass, to make the agent accessible on more models. Prefer TOOL-side fixes that hold for any model (list_models returns editors in rank order or marks the best; Head Swap itself refuses a box covering most of the person; describe_model states which slot a sheet goes in); prompt wording only where the tool cannot know intent (the named-model re-run). Overfitting guard: every fix is a general rule we would write in the docs, never a per-case hint; tune watching one model, verify on another; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 must stay 22/22 x3. Price rule (Fabio): only models within 2x of the pick's OFF-promo price (/usr/bin/bash.06 in / /usr/bin/bash.18 out / /usr/bin/bash.015 cached per 1M; DeepInfra's API pricing is the full price, the website shows promos). Targets and screen scores: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 18/22 (also on Ollama as qwen3.6:35b-a3b, 24 GB class), openai/gpt-oss-120b 14/22, google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 14/22, nvidia/Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 10/22, openai/gpt-oss-20b 10/22 (14 GB on Ollama, the 16 GB local hope). Unlisted models get no reasoningEffort in the harness; check replies for leaked deliberation before calling a fail. Blocker at carding: services/agentLoop.mjs is claimed by MPI-908 (the Mascots session).
